guide.runTerminal: Run this command in your terminal.
guide.claudeCode3: Choose Schuly, then Authenticate, and finish the sign-in in your browser.
guide.keyHeader: Add the key as a header when you register the server.
guide.desktop1: Open Settings (Customize) and go to Connectors.
guide.desktop3: Enter the name Schuly and the URL {{url}}, then choose Add.
guide.desktop4: Choose Connect and sign in to Schuly in your browser.
guide.desktopNote: This also applies to claude.ai. The connector is reached from Anthropic's cloud, so Schuly must be available at a public URL.
guide.headersHint: If your plan offers custom headers, open the connector's advanced settings and add this request header.
guide.chatgpt1: Open Settings, then Apps & Connectors, then Advanced settings, and turn on Developer mode.
guide.chatgpt2: Choose Create (or open chatgpt.com/plugins, choose +, then Add custom MCP server).
guide.chatgpt3: Enter the name Schuly and the URL {{url}}.
guide.chatgpt4: Set authentication to OAuth, create it, and sign in to Schuly in your browser.
guide.chatgptNote: ChatGPT connects from the cloud, so it needs the public URL of Schuly.
guide.chatgptKey: ChatGPT only supports OAuth sign-in, so API keys do not work there.
guide.cursor1: Use the install button, or add this to ~/.cursor/mcp.json.
guide.cursor3: Next to Schuly, click Needs login and finish the sign-in in your browser.
guide.envKey: Add a headers entry and put the key in the SCHULY_MCP_KEY environment variable.
guide.vscode1: Use the install button, or add this to .vscode/mcp.json.
guide.vscode2: Start the Schuly server from the file or the MCP view.
guide.vscode3: Choose Allow when asked to sign in, and finish the sign-in in your browser.
guide.vscodeNote: VS Code (GitHub Copilot) uses the key "servers", not "mcpServers".
guide.vscodeKey: VS Code asks for the key once and keeps it out of the file.
guide.windsurf1: Open ~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json (or the MCP panel, then Configure).
guide.windsurf3: Click Refresh in the MCP panel and finish the sign-in in your browser.
guide.gemini1: Run this command, or add the server to ~/.gemini/settings.json.
guide.gemini2: Start Gemini CLI and run /mcp auth schuly.
guide.finishBrowser: Finish the sign-in in your browser.
guide.passHeader: Pass the key as a header when you register the server.
guide.codex1: Run these commands, or add the server to ~/.codex/config.toml.
guide.codex2: Finish the sign-in in your browser when codex mcp login opens it.
